meta.prompt_suffix: Glossy semi-3D rendered illustration with a polished anime finish: smooth volumetric shading, strong specular highlights, soft ambient occlusion, clean bold outlines, vivid saturated colors, bright cinematic key light with sparkle and lens-flare accents, shallow depth of field on the background. Characters are "countryball" style spheres — a perfectly round glossy ball rendered with realistic sphere volume and a bright highlight, its entire surface wrapped edge to edge in its identity mark (an accurate national flag for a country, or the company's actual logo and brand color for a corporation), with large expressive cartoon eyes and mouth drawn directly on that surface, attached to a small human body in a business suit, work uniform, or military uniform, with small black gloved hands. The identity mark stays large and unbroken so it reads instantly at thumbnail size. Expressions are extreme and instantly readable at small size. The machinery, vehicles, and industrial objects in the scene are rendered with crisp mechanical detail and realistic metallic materials, contrasting against the stylized spheres. The only legible characters anywhere in the image are the short Korean Hangul labels and numerals explicitly named in the scene description above, rendered crisply and correctly as real Korean letterforms; every other surface that would carry writing shows entries printed too small and slightly out of focus to read, never invented English words and never fake Chinese characters. NO large title or caption overlay text, no watermark. 16:9 widescreen YouTube thumbnail.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 한 줄: 「자루째 쓸어 담았는데 자루 틈에서 화면 하나가 새고 있다.」 2026.8 등록 손전화까지 전량 회수(데일리NK 2026.08.21)가 근거. 회수한 양이 많을수록 겁먹은 게 드러나는 구조라 크기 대비를 주력으로 썼다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the bottom three-eighths of the frame height is one clean continuous surface — plain grey concrete ground — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every character, object, prop, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper five-eighths above it. Anything the characters hold or stand on sits at mid height, never near the bottom edge. Scene: a colossal heap of confiscated feature phones, MP3 players, memory cards and tangled earphone cords rises like a scree mountain across the centre of the upper five-eighths, each handset rendered with crisp mechanical detail and realistic scuffed plastic and metal. A single countryball sphere stands at the right on top of the heap, its whole surface wrapped edge to edge in the North Korean flag — broad red band with a white circle bearing a red five-pointed star, thin white and blue stripes above and below — wearing an oversized olive military officer's cap and a dark high-collared tunic, small black gloved hands hauling the mouth of an enormous burlap sack shut over the pile at mid height. From a split seam low on the sack one phone screen still shines a hard cold blue beam upward across his face. A stencilled wooden crate beside the heap reads "회수품" in Korean Hangul in large characters. Background: a blurred grey border-town skyline of low tile roofs under a flat overcast sky. His expression: eyes narrowed into two hard angry slits with pinprick pupils, eyebrows driven into a sharp V, teeth gritted and bared, one fat sweat drop flying off the side of the sphere, a red anger vein mark on his cheek, small motion streak lines behind the sack.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 한 줄: 「걸린 쪽이 고개를 안 숙이고 눈을 마주친다.」 2026.2 혜산에서 MP3로 한국 노래를 듣다 단속된 청년이 보위원의 추궁에 '가사가 평소 생각과 같아서 꽂혔다'고 맞선 사건(데일리NK 2026.03.19)이 근거. 양쪽 다 인공기 구체이므로 제복과 이어폰으로 정체를 갈랐고, 표정 온도를 정반대로 뒀다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the bottom three-eighths of the frame height is one clean continuous surface — smooth packed-earth alley floor — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every character, object, prop, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper five-eighths above it. Anything the characters hold or stand on sits at mid height, never near the bottom edge. Scene: a narrow alley in a North Korean town, two countryball spheres facing each other across the upper five-eighths. On the left, larger and closer, a sphere wrapped edge to edge in the North Korean flag — broad red band with a white circle bearing a red five-pointed star, thin white and blue stripes above and below — in a dark state-security uniform with red collar tabs and a peaked cap, leaning in with one small black gloved index finger jabbed forward. On the right, smaller but standing straight, a second sphere in the identical North Korean flag wrap but dressed as a young civilian in a long black leather coat with a white earphone cord running up its side, chin lifted, not stepping back. Between them at mid height floats a chunky silver MP3 player rendered in crisp mechanical detail, its cord stretched taut between the two, with three or four small cracked-plastic fragments and spark accents suspended around it. A paper notice on the alley wall behind them reads "강연회" in Korean Hangul in large characters. Background: blurred grey concrete houses and a bare utility pole. Expressions in hard contrast — the officer sphere: eyes bulging with whites showing, eyebrows crushed down, mouth stretched open mid-shout, two sweat drops flying, jagged shout lines radiating behind it. The young sphere: eyes half-lidded and steady, looking straight back, one eyebrow slightly raised, mouth a small flat unimpressed line, no sweat at all.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 한 줄: 「총 들고 초소에 선 쪽 주머니에서도 노래가 새어 나온다.」 군 내부 교육영상에서 20대 병사가 괴뢰 노래 160여 곡 시청을 자백한 사례(KBS 입수 북한 내부 문건)가 근거. 감시하는 쪽과 감시당하는 쪽이 같은 사람이라는 게 이 편의 통쾌 포인트라 한 구체 안에 몰아넣었다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the bottom three-eighths of the frame height is one clean continuous surface — plain frozen riverbank ground — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every character, object, prop, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper five-eighths above it. Anything the characters hold or stand on sits at mid height, never near the bottom edge. Scene: extreme close-up of one countryball sphere filling most of the upper five-eighths, its surface wrapped edge to edge in the North Korean flag — broad red band with a white circle bearing a red five-pointed star, thin white and blue stripes above and below — wearing an oversized fur-flap winter army cap and a padded green sentry coat, a rifle strap crossing its body, one small black gloved hand pressed flat over its own chest pocket at mid height. A thin white earphone cord escapes from under its collar, and a hard cold blue glow leaks between its glove fingers from the hidden phone screen, throwing a blue rim along the bottom of the sphere. Behind it, sharply out of focus, a small concrete guard post with a signboard reading "국경초소" in Korean Hangul in large characters, and far across the water a bright blurred bokeh wall of warm Chinese city lights while the near bank stays cold and unlit. Its expression: both eyes swivelled hard to one side toward the distant lights, pupils shrunk to pinpricks, mouth clamped into a tight wavy nervous line, one enormous sweat drop hanging at the top of the sphere, three small shake lines vibrating along its edge.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 확정 제목의 「손전화를 걷어들인」을 물건 하나로 압축한 장. 2025.9 국가보위성이 '4/4분기까지 중국 손전화 사용자를 단 1명도 남기지 말라'며 총살까지 경고한 지시(데일리NK 2025.10.15)가 근거다. 자물쇠와 쇠사슬로 잠근 회수함인데도 틈에서 빛이 새는 게 제목의 '진짜 이유'를 미리 보여준다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the bottom three-eighths of the frame height is one clean continuous surface — smooth grey depot floor — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every character, object, prop, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper five-eighths above it. Anything the characters hold or stand on sits at mid height, never near the bottom edge. Scene: a gigantic riveted steel collection box, taller than everything else, dominates the centre of the upper five-eighths, rendered with crisp mechanical detail, realistic scratched grey paint, a heavy padlock and thick chain across its lid; its front panel is stencilled "회수함" in Korean Hangul in large characters. A countryball sphere wrapped edge to edge in the North Korean flag — broad red band with a white circle bearing a red five-pointed star, thin white and blue stripes above and below — in an olive officer's cap and dark tunic stands on top of the box at mid height, small black gloved hands planted on its knees as it leans over to peer down. Out of the box's seams and keyhole, hard cold blue light and dozens of tiny floating music-note-shaped light motes escape upward and drift around the sphere. Far below on the right, a much smaller sphere in the same flag wrap dressed as a young civilian with an earphone cord tilts up to watch the escaping light. Background: a blurred warehouse interior with stacked crates. The officer sphere's expression: eyes stretched into huge round circles of alarm with tiny shrunken pupils, mouth pulled into a rigid open rectangle, eyebrows shot up, four sweat drops scattered around the top of the sphere, shake lines along its rim.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 제목 전반부 「걸렸는데, 되레 큰소리쳤다」를 손이 닿는 접촉 동작으로 이행한 장. 정권 쪽 손이 실제로 청년의 손전화를 잡아 빼야 '걷어들인'이 보이고, 그 상황에서도 청년이 눈을 피하지 않는 게 제목의 역전이다. 4번과 달리 크기 차이를 줄이고 정면 시선 충돌로 승부한다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the bottom three-eighths of the frame height is one clean continuous surface — plain swept courtyard ground — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every character, object, prop, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper five-eighths above it. Anything the characters hold or stand on sits at mid height, never near the bottom edge. Scene: two countryball spheres locked face to face at the centre of the upper five-eighths, both wrapped edge to edge in the identical North Korean flag — broad red band with a white circle bearing a red five-pointed star, thin white and blue stripes above and below — distinguished only by dress. Left: the state sphere in an olive military officer's cap, greatcoat and red collar tabs, its small black gloved hand clamped around a battered black handset and yanking it sideways out of the other's grip, a cloth collection sack slung over its shoulder already bulging with handsets. Right: the young civilian sphere in a black leather coat with a white earphone cord, its own small gloved hand still gripping the other end of the same handset at mid height, refusing to let the cord snap, head tilted up so the two spheres are eye to eye. Between their hands the stretched earphone cord and three small cracked-plastic fragments hang in the air with a sharp spark accent. A paper list pinned to the wall behind reads "압수목록" in Korean Hangul in large characters. Background: blurred grey apartment blocks. Expressions in hard contrast — the state sphere: eyebrows crushed into a V, eyes glaring with shrunken pupils, mouth wide open mid-bellow, three sweat drops, red vein mark. The young sphere: eyes wide, clear and locked straight on the officer without blinking, brows level, mouth a firm closed line with one corner slightly pulled up.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 제목 후반 「평양이 손전화를 걷어들인 진짜 이유」의 답을 표정 하나로 말하는 장. 손전화 산을 다 걷고도 뒤가 켜져 있는 걸 본 얼굴이다. 4·5번이 물건과 대결이었으므로 이 장은 얼굴 단독으로 벌렸다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the bottom three-eighths of the frame height is one clean continuous surface — plain pale sky-grey backdrop — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every character, object, prop, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper five-eighths above it. Anything the characters hold or stand on sits at mid height, never near the bottom edge. Scene: one countryball sphere fills nearly the whole upper five-eighths in extreme close-up, its surface wrapped edge to edge in the North Korean flag — broad red band with a white circle bearing a red five-pointed star, thin white and blue stripes above and below — wearing an oversized olive military officer's cap tipped slightly back, its small black gloved hands raised on either side of itself in a startled reflex at mid height. Directly behind it, sharply out of focus but unmistakable, a long ridge of confiscated handsets stretches across the frame, and scattered through that dark ridge a dozen tiny screens are still switched on, each a small hard blue point of light, with faint music-note-shaped motes rising off them. Background beyond that: a blurred pale concrete hall. Its expression: eyes blown into two enormous white circles with tiny black pinprick pupils shoved off-centre as they cut backward over its own shoulder, mouth yanked down into a huge open wobbling frown showing the tongue, eyebrows lifted and broken in the middle, five fat sweat drops flung outward, thick shake lines and a pale shocked highlight streaking across the top of the sphere.

thumbnails.concept_ko: [모순] 핵을 쌓은 체제가 노래 한 곡짜리 기계를 겁내 통째로 걷어 간다 / [남김] ① 좌·중앙·우 3분할 스케일 대비 ② 중앙 상단 5/8의 대형 진땀 얼굴(모순이 '누가 겁내는가'에 걸려 있어 정권 구체로 고정) ③ 상단 좌우 코너를 깨끗이 비워 인용 말풍선 자리 유지 ④ 하단 단색 면으로 메인 2줄 자리 확보 / [바꿈] ① 피사체(축구선수단·SANCTION 금고 → 압수 손전화 더미와 회수 상자) ② 배경 무대(서울 스카이라인 → 불 꺼진 북한 국경 마을 밤) ③ 좌측 인물(우는 여성 → 고개를 든 청년 구체, 슬픔에서 항변으로 역전). 렌더링만 국기볼로 바꾸고 화면 분할·시점·인물 위치는 앵커 그대로다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the bottom three-eighths of the frame height is one clean continuous surface — plain dark night ground — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every character, object, prop, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper five-eighths above it. Anything the characters hold or stand on sits at mid height, never near the bottom edge. Scene: one wide frame split into three vertical panels. LEFT PANEL: a blacked-out North Korean border village at night, low tile roofs and bare poles with no lit windows, and standing among them one small countryball sphere wrapped edge to edge in the North Korean flag — broad red band with a white circle bearing a red five-pointed star, thin white and blue stripes above and below — dressed as a young civilian in a black leather coat with a white earphone cord, chin tilted up and shoulders squared. CENTRE PANEL: a far larger sphere in the identical flag wrap but in an olive military officer's cap and dark greatcoat, drawn at least three times the height of the left sphere, facing straight out of the frame, no hands raised. RIGHT PANEL: a heaped mountain of confiscated handsets, MP3 players and memory cards rendered in crisp mechanical detail beside a stacked wooden crate stencilled "회수품" in Korean Hangul in large characters, one buried screen still glowing hard cold blue in the middle of the dark pile. The upper left and upper right corners are kept clean and uncluttered. Background: blurred dark ridgeline and cold night sky. Centre sphere's expression: eyes stretched into two huge round circles with tiny pinprick pupils staring dead ahead at the viewer, eyebrows shoved up and bent, mouth hanging open in a wide wobbling oval, six fat sweat drops streaming down the sphere, heavy shake lines all around its rim. Left sphere's expression by contrast: calm half-lidded eyes, level brows, a small flat closed mouth, no sweat.

thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the bottom three-eighths of the frame height is one clean continuous surface — smooth flat trial-ground floor — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every character, object, prop, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper five-eighths above it. LEFT PANEL: an open-air trial ground under harsh white floodlights — a low stage with two small grey-tunic spheres seen from behind, and in front of them several rows of small young civilian countryball spheres seated as spectators, most of them shown from behind or in three-quarter view slouching, one visibly yawning and one leaning back with half-lidded bored eyes; a red banner strung above the stage reads "공개재판" in Korean Hangul in large characters. CENTRE PANEL: a large sphere wrapped edge to edge in the North Korean flag — broad red band with a white circle bearing a red five-pointed star, thin white and blue stripes above and below — in an olive military officer's cap and dark greatcoat, chest-up framing, one small black gloved hand pressed flat against the top of its own sphere at mid height as its head turns away from the bored crowd. RIGHT PANEL: a second sphere in the same flag wrap but in a plain state-security uniform, seen from behind, hauling a cardboard box of seized handsets at chest height with cold blue screen light leaking from the box seam. The upper left and upper right corners are kept clean and uncluttered. Background: blurred floodlight poles and a flat dark sky. Centre sphere's expression: both eyes squeezed shut into tight downward arcs, eyebrows knotted together, mouth pulled into a small tight grimace with the teeth showing on one side, three sweat drops sliding down, a heavy blue vertical shadow of dismay falling over the upper part of the sphere.
